title: Oven Roasted Egyptian Lamb Tagine
description: Sweet, dense lamb tagine perfect for a sick day, made low‑fat and still packed with flavor.

ingredients.name: Lamb leg
ingredients.notes: lean cut, trimmed of excess fat

instructions: Pat the lamb dry and season it with salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cinnamon.
Seared the lamb in a skillet with one teaspoon of olive oil until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a baking dish and add the sliced onions, carrots, celery, garlic, and chopped apricots.
Drizzle honey over the lamb, spread tomato paste over the vegetables, and sprinkle crushed rosemary.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and pour the chicken broth over the lamb, adding raisins and chopped dates.
Transfer the entire dish to a pressure cooker, seal, and cook on high pressure for 30 minutes.
Release the pressure naturally, then remove the lamb and shred or slice it as desired.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with fresh parsley.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
